documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27 during an earnings conference call. Management highlighted year-on-year growth across revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax, supported by strong sales momentum and disciplined project execution in its redevelopment portfolio across Mumbai and adjoining regions. The company remains focused on asset-light redevelopment partnerships with housing societies and institutions while maintaining an ongoing project sales book and expanding its upcoming project pipeline. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong financial performance in H1 FY27, with revenue growing 53% year-on-year to INR 127.64 crore and EBITDA increasing 63% to INR 26.19 crore. Management highlighted continuous progress across ongoing redevelopment projects such as Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, and Rashmi Delight, alongside the addition of a new redevelopment project.
